capabilities: Embed Spotify, Vimeo and SoundCloud players in notes
Render GitHub repository, gist, and issue/PR cards
Embed CodePen pens and Steam store widgets
Fall back to Open Graph cards for any generic URL
Configure provider toggles, GitHub token, theme mode and cache duration
extras: The plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a roadmap of candidate providers and notes that YouTube is deliberately excluded because Obsidian embeds it natively.
intentEvidence: Embed rich media from GitHub, Spotify, CodePen, and more directly in your notes.
problem: Obsidian's native embeds cover only some media types, so links to services like GitHub, Spotify or CodePen otherwise appear as plain URLs or need separate plugins per provider.
summary: Renders rich media embeds (GitHub, Spotify, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Steam, CodePen) from fenced code blocks in reading mode.
